semantic_review.method: Reviewed all comparison report prose, JSON top-level and nested field schemas across every selected manifest/ledger/graded record, representative actual final-answer text, final parent-audit contents and negative capacity errors before copying. Used explicit artifact selection and parsed semantic structures, not a regular-expression secret scan or redaction/DLP pipeline.
semantic_review.reports: Historical final comparisons and one completed DEV8 acceptance statement contain aggregate scores, candidate hashes, limitations and provenance paths. Bytes unchanged; historical future/pending statements remain historical, not current claims.
semantic_review.parent_audits: Final parent audits contain runtime hashes/paths, model identities, snapshot hashes and compression timing (not snapshot bytes), manifests, final answer records, scores and validation booleans. Three supplementary session audits contain hashes, match checks and tool names/arguments/pagination counts, not session transcripts or complete tool-result history.
semantic_review.manifests: Lightweight declarative run identity, model name/effort/limits, SDK, arms, question IDs, input/plugin/wrapper hashes, generic system prompt and original filesystem paths. No agent configuration, auth/settings or environment files copied.
semantic_review.results_jsonl: Parsed all 72 ledgers: 210 answered/explicitly graded rows plus two question-level compression-error records; final answers, yes/no grades, timings, token counters and snapshot hashes. They are not SDK session streams.
semantic_review.graded_records: 210 per-arm judge.json files embed the final answer/result plus explicit grade and answer/snapshot/run digests; answer.json and status.json would duplicate them and are omitted. Final-answer text is intentionally retained benchmark output, not full history or answer-session transcripts.
semantic_review.negative_result: dev8-base-ed09d12 is retained: six answered questions / 18 arm records, two compression preflight failures (343768 and 341237 estimates against 340000 ceiling), raw denominator eight, native 0/8, grep 4/8, production 6/8. Not called a complete clean DEV8 run.
semantic_review.pilot_policy: All separate pilot runs excluded, including invalid hard8-sol-high-2ea9b1c9; no pilot is counted again. Formal final-group records are counted once even where judge/ledger/audit repeat their contents.
semantic_review.privacy_boundary: No session.jsonl, full source history, snapshot payload, credential/env/model-auth/settings, caches or dependencies read/copied. Original path and hash references remain in frozen documents and do not imply those referenced payloads are archived.
